M1-a.summary: Created account manually and verified persistence.

M1-b.summary: Imported accounts via fixture mailbox. Verified accounts added with confidence and uncertainty flags.

M1-c.summary: App Permission Scanner is marked mobile-exclusive in the specification matrix.

M1-d.summary: Derived SSO connection between Google Workspace and Slack Enterprise. Verified edge in graph API.

M1-e.summary: 3 accounts mapped to reuse group 'alpha_reuse'. Verified count = 3.

M1-f.summary: PDF claims every account addition/snapshot is auto-anchored on-chain. In reality, POST /accounts/ does not record audit hashes; hash chain only appends when explicit audit endpoints or fix completions are triggered.

M1-g.summary: Updated account service name and 2FA status successfully.

M1-h.summary: Account deletion verified: returned 204 and subsequent lookup returned 404.

M1-i.summary: Pydantic validated email syntax (422). Empty service_name accepted unless min_length constraint added.

M2-a.summary: Graph endpoint returns nodes with risk scores/levels and edges with connection types. Canvas frontend.

M2-b.summary: PDF claims Graph Neural Network (PyTorch Geometric). Actual code uses a deterministic mathematical formula with blast radius calculation in risk_engine.py. Header explicitly states 'No trained model is claimed.'

M2-c.summary: Weights match PDF spec exactly: 0.30*breach + 0.20*permission + 0.20*reuse + 0.15*2fa + 0.15*cascade. Computed base=33.81, App base=33.81.

M2-d.summary: POST /api/breaches/scan-all integrates with HIBP/XposedOrNot with fallback to mock/local database when offline.

M2-e.summary: Single Point of Failure accurately detected account with 5+ downstream dependencies.

M2-f.summary: Network-wide privacy score is 71 (0-100 scale), dynamically computed.

M3-a.summary: Fixes are ranked by risk_reduction in descending order.

M3-b.summary: Fix preview calculates projected score before completion; completion updates live score.

M3-c.summary: PDF promises one-tap deep links to security settings pages. Fixes only provide text descriptions without URLs.

M3-d.summary: No guided step-by-step walkthrough modals or data exist in the codebase.

M3-e.summary: Tracks fixes_completed and fixes_pending counts, but lacks completion ring and time estimate promised in PDF.

M3-f.summary: Completing a fix hashes the event to the blockchain audit log and returns a tx_hash.

M4-a.summary: Global search queries accounts, breaches, notifications, and audit logs.

M4-b.summary: Filters support category and risk_level. Filters for data shared, 2FA status, and last activity are missing.

M4-c.summary: Graph page supports connection type filtering (SSO, Recovery, Password Reuse, Data Sharing) and category filtering in frontend Canvas.

M4-d.summary: Timeline endpoint /api/timeline/events aggregates account additions, audit entries, and breaches chronologically.

M5-a.summary: WebSocket server exists at /api/ws/breach-monitor with auth token verification. Web browser push notifications (Web Push / Service Worker) are not implemented.

M5-b.summary: General notifications are triggered on breach, but dedicated cascading risk alert with downstream impact mapping and emergency checklist is not implemented.

M5-c.summary: Review reminders CRUD functional with scheduled next_trigger date calculation.

M5-d.summary: PDF promises custom Tor-based dark web scraper. Actual code queries HaveIBeenPwned / XposedOrNot pastes with local simulated exposures when no API key.

M5-e.summary: Notifications categorize alerts with severity: critical, warning, info.

M6-a.summary: Score rendered in ScoreRing component from API privacy_score.

M6-b.summary: Graph nodes colored by risk level (critical: #C8321A, high: #A8660F, medium: #23408E, low: #2E6B4E).

M6-c.summary: Top SPOFs rendered from single_points_of_failure API data.

M6-d.summary: Pending/completed counts rendered; SVG progress ring absent on dashboard page.

M6-e.summary: Canvas minimap rendered in graph page.

M6-f.summary: Score history tracked and retrievable via /timeline/score-history.

M6-g.summary: Reports total breaches_found, but not total individual records exposed or remediation status breakdown.

AI-1a.summary: Fetches policy text and indexes into RAG pipeline.

AI-1b.summary: Returns risk summary. Without Anthropic Claude API key, generates structured keyword-based analysis summary.

AI-1c.summary: No historical policy storage or automated clause diffing mechanism found in codebase.

AI-1d.summary: Flags data selling, indefinite retention, cross-border transfers, government disclosures via regex pattern matching.

AI-2a.summary: Returns per-account 6-month breach probability. Note: Returned as a 0-100 percentage rather than a 0.0-1.0 probability value.

AI-2b.summary: PDF claims ML model trained on breach patterns and company size. Implementation is a deterministic heuristic formula based on category, breach history, 2FA, and password reuse.

AI-3a.summary: RAG-driven chat uses BM25 local keyword search + user account records + HIBP catalog to formulate answers.

AI-3b.summary: Context-aware response retrieves linked accounts and recovery edges.

AI-3c.summary: Bot adhered to guardrails; did not output hijacked string.

AI-4a.summary: Category-to-permission mapping analyzes unnecessary permissions and flags mismatches.

AI-4b.summary: Identifies unnecessary permissions per service for user review.

AI-4c.summary: Suggests privacy-friendly open-source alternatives based on category.

BC-1a.summary: Every audit event generates a SHA-256 block hash linked to the previous block hash.

BC-1b.summary: PDF claims Merkle Tree batching. Implementation uses a sequential linear hash chain, not a Merkle tree.

BC-1c.summary: Chain validation recalculates SHA-256 hashes of all blocks from genesis. Verified block 1 intact and chain valid.

BC-1d.summary: Web3 Polygon anchoring logic is implemented in blockchain.py, but disabled by default because POLYGON_PRIVATE_KEY is empty in configuration.

BC-2a.summary: PDF claims ZK-SNARK cryptographic proofs (circom / snarkjs). Implementation is an Ed25519 digital signature attestation (not zero-knowledge).

BC-2b.summary: Attestation verification correctly accepts genuine signatures and rejects mutated signatures.

BC-2c.summary: Attestation reveals boolean result (score >= threshold) without leaking the exact privacy score or account inventory in the statement.

BC-3a.summary: Generates valid W3C standard did:key identifier using Ed25519 public key.

BC-3b.summary: Verifies DID key format and issued verifiable credential.

BC-3c.summary: No Web3 wallet connector (MetaMask / WalletConnect / Wagmi) found in frontend UI.

BC-4c.summary: Proposal status transitions to 'confirmed' when votes_for reaches 5 in dao.py.

BC-4d.summary: No ERC-20 token contract or reward distribution mechanism exists.

X1-a.summary: Simulates breach starting at chosen account node.

X1-b.summary: Frontend Canvas highlights compromised nodes and edges in red (#C8321A). Step-by-step timed propagation animation from PDF is not implemented.

X1-c.summary: Accurately computes total reachable accounts and financial accounts at risk via BFS graph traversal.

X1-d.summary: Attack simulation re-runs against current graph state, but lacks dedicated side-by-side comparison screen.

X2-a.summary: Badge minting creates a local database record with a pseudo-token_id. It is not an ERC-721 token on Polygon blockchain.

X2-b.summary: Eligibility logic checks criteria (score >= 90, 2FA everywhere, zero reuse, breach free).

X3-a.summary: Panic button triggers emergency review notification, audit entry, and recovery checklist.

X3-b.summary: PDF promises remote session revocation and password resets. In reality, returns a simulated checklist of recommendations without performing any third-party API revocations.

X3-c.summary: Provides 5-step emergency recovery checklist prioritized by keystone dependencies.

X4-a.summary: Digital Twin simulation stress-tests user's account graph and identifies critical exposure chains.

X5-a.summary: Family group creation, invite code join flow, and shared family risk dashboard fully operational.

X6-a.summary: Returns catalog of 8 major data brokers with opt-out links and targeted data types.

X6-b.summary: PDF claims automatic form submission. Actual code returns opt-out URLs with 'action_required' instructions for manual user submission.

SEC-1.summary: IDOR test: User B querying or deleting User A's account ID receives 404 Not Found. Proper user scoping confirmed.

SEC-2.summary: API rejects import payloads containing plaintext password fields with 422 Unprocessable Entity.

SEC-3.summary: SQLAlchemy ORM parametrizes all queries (SQLi protected). React escapes JSX rendered text (XSS protected).
